mapper.sql: data_source_id AS dataSourceId, data_source_code AS dataSourceCode, data_source_name AS dataSourceName, engine_type AS engineType, host, port, database_name AS databaseName, username, password_token AS passwordToken, connection_params_json AS connectionParamsJson, max_pool_size AS maxPoolSize, status, last_check_result AS lastCheckResult, last_check_message AS lastCheckMessage, last_check_time AS lastCheckTime, description, version, created_by AS createdBy, updated_by AS updatedBy, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_data_source (data_source_id, data_source_code, data_source_name, engine_type, host, port, database_name, username, password_token, connection_params_json, max_pool_size, status, last_check_result, last_check_message, last_check_time, description, version, created_by, updated_by, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{row.dataSourceId}, #{row.dataSourceCode}, #{row.dataSourceName}, #{row.engineType}, #{row.host}, #{row.port}, #{row.databaseName}, #{row.username}, #{row.passwordToken}, #{row.connectionParamsJson}, #{row.maxPoolSize}, #{row.status}, #{row.lastCheckResult}, #{row.lastCheckMessage}, #{row.lastCheckTime}, #{row.description}, #{row.version}, #{row.createdBy}, #{row.updatedBy}, #{row.createTime}, #{row.updateTime})

SELECT FROM t_data_source WHERE data_source_id IN #{id}

SELECT FROM t_data_source

SELECT data_source_id AS dataSourceId, version, status FROM t_data_source WHERE status <> 'DELETED'
mapper.update: UPDATE t_data_source SET data_source_name = #{next.dataSourceName}, engine_type = #{next.engineType}, host = #{next.host}, port = #{next.port}, database_name = #{next.databaseName}, username = #{next.username}, password_token = #{next.passwordToken}, connection_params_json = #{next.connectionParamsJson}, max_pool_size = #{next.maxPoolSize}, description = #{next.description}, version = version + 1, updated_by = #{next.updatedBy}, update_time = #{next.updateTime} WHERE data_source_id = #{row.dataSourceId} AND version = #{row.version} AND status = #{row.status}
